_readme: Hand-labelled expectations for the real reports in app/uploads/, read directly from the
page images by eye. Scored by tools/accuracy_report.py.
EXPECTATION FORMS (per canonical parameter):
null                      -> the report genuinely does NOT contain this parameter.
Extracting anything here is a FALSE POSITIVE, which is
scored separately because a value invented for a field the
report never stated is the most dangerous failure mode.
"4.31 cm"                 -> exact expected stored value (numeric fields).
{"any": [...]}            -> the report states several equally-correct readings
(e.g. two EF methods printed side by side). Any one passes.
{"contains": "..."}       -> qualitative finding; the stored text must contain this
substring, case-insensitive. Exact prose is not pinned
because wording is normalized differently by each path.
{"qualitative_ok": true}  -> the report states this structure only in prose ("Left atrial
size is normal"), never as a measurement. A descriptor or an
empty field both pass; a NUMBER is still a false positive,
because no number was ever printed for it.
Omitted parameter         -> not scored for this report (deliberately unlabelled).
Numeric values follow the project's canonical storage format (extractor._format_value_with_unit):
cm for linear dimensions, % for EF, mmHg for PASP, unitless for E/A.
